summary: Auto-Pulizia Schede feature verified end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_auto_archive.py — POST /api/schede/auto-archive archives only schede whose latest checkin (or created_at fallback) is >60 days old, ignores schede with a recent checkin, is idempotent (2nd run returns count=0, archived_codes=[]), and returns {archived_codes, count, days}. GET /api/schede filter works for archived=false (default, includes legacy docs missing the field), archived=true, and archived=all. PUT /api/schede/{code}/archive toggles archived + archived_at correctly (401 without JWT, 404 on unknown code). Public GET /api/schede/{code} returns 404 for archived schede while active/legacy ones return 200. Auth guard confirmed (401) on /schede/auto-archive, PUT /schede/{code}/archive, and GET /schede. Frontend: verified via Playwright on the public preview URL — password gymhost2026 → dashboard; the Archivio tile shows badge=1 with subtitle '1 scheda archiviata' when a seeded archived doc exists, tap navigates to /host/archive where the card renders with client_name, code pill, 'Archiviata il DD/MM/YYYY' meta and both Ripristina + Elimina buttons visible; empty state (no archived docs) shows no badge, subtitle 'Nessuna scheda archiviata' and empty-archive component 'ARCHIVIO VUOTO' on /host/archive. Ripristina/Elimina onPress handlers use RN Alert.alert (no-op on Expo web) so the confirmation flow was skipped per instructions — button visibility + testIDs confirmed instead. No functional bugs found.
action_items: OPTIONAL polish (not a blocker): in /app/frontend/app/host/archive.tsx the `load()` callback wraps the api.get in try/finally with no `catch`; if the token has expired and the interceptor rejects, the axios error becomes an unhandled promise rejection and the Expo dev-web build shows a red 'Uncaught Error: Request failed with status code 401' overlay before the redirect to /host-unlock kicks in. The redirect DOES happen (correct behavior); only the overlay is cosmetic and only in dev-web. Adding a `catch {}` around the api.get in load() suppresses it. Native/production builds are unaffected.

OPTIONAL polish: backend `int(payload.days or 60)` in POST /api/schede/auto-archive means days=0 is coerced to 60 instead of being clamped to the documented lower bound of 1 (upper clamp 365 works). Behaviour is safe (no unwanted archives), but the min=1 clamp is unreachable via days=0. Consider `int(payload.days if payload.days is not None else 60)`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /schede/auto-archive is correct and idempotent: it filters {$or: [{archived:false}, {archived:{$exists:false}}]} (so legacy docs are considered) and uses the latest checkin timestamp with created_at fallback. Handles str-datetime edge case defensively.
server.py GET /schede/{code} correctly hides archived schede from unauthenticated clients (returns 404, not 403 — good, prevents enumeration).
server.py PUT /schede/{code}/archive correctly clears archived_at when un-archiving.
archive.tsx cards look good — Ripristina/Elimina hit-targets are 44+ pt (paddingVertical:12 + text/icon).
host/index.tsx `load()` swallows the auto-archive error with `try{}catch{}`, so a failing auto-archive never blocks the dashboard — correct fire-and-forget pattern.
Minor DRY: the `libraryTile` style is reused 3× (Libreria / Riscaldamento / Archivio) with hard-coded marginTop:-2 overrides. Consider extracting a <ListTile /> component.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (populated + empty archive flows verified on mobile viewport 375x812)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests: 4 schede seeded via pymongo inside a module fixture (TEST_AA_OldNoCI, TEST_AA_OldStaleCI, TEST_AA_FreshCI, TEST_AA_Legacy) plus 2 checkins, all cleaned up in teardown. Frontend UI test: 1 archived scheda seeded (code TUI001) via a bash step, deleted immediately after the populated-state check. Grep confirms zero TEST_AA_* / TUI* documents remain in the DB after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_auto_archive.py is fully self-contained (seeds + cleanup via pymongo, reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env). Safe to rerun alongside backend_test.py — code prefixes are disjoint (TAA vs TEST_). If a future iteration adds a dedicated archive-only client route or a scheduled cron, retest the auto-archive endpoint after re-seeding old docs. The one dev-web red-screen overlay observed (401 on /host/archive when token cleared) is expected axios behavior and NOT a bug on native builds.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature is production-ready.
